details:
Q1: Which part of the coding-workflows repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) One specific workflow, such as clarify, plan, implement, review_autofix, orchestrate, validate or update-workflows. Name it in your /answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B) One helper script or prompt template under `scripts/` or `prompts/`. Name the file in your /answer.
C) Documentation only (README.md, docs/, or an agents.d/ fragment).
D) Something else. Describe the target in your /answer.
Q2: What problem should the change fix?
Choices:
A) A bug or failure, with a run ID, log excerpt or reproduction steps. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Performance or cost, such as runtime, token use or GitHub API calls. Include the metric you want to improve.
C) A new capability or behaviour change. Describe the expected behaviour.
D) Clarity or maintainability of the code or docs, with no change in behaviour.
Q3: How will we know the issue is done?
Choices:
A) A specific observable result, such as a test that passes, a run that succeeds or a measured improvement. State it in your /answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A described behaviour change, checked by new or updated contract tests.
C) The issue is too broad to finish in one change; close it and open specific follow-up issues instead.
